correctness.rationale: The proof uses the exact identity weight = positive-support size + |V_2| + 2|V_3|. Outer independence makes the positive support a vertex cover, and the half-graph matching forces size at least n. Zeros on both sides require two excess units on each side; one-sided zeros give sharp support-size-dependent excess bounds. Equality is then classified through the canonical maximum-independent-set staircase and leaf forcing. A direct exhaustive checker verifies the finite boundaries and reproduces the theorem through n=5.
